crop: Cassava / manioc (Manihot esculenta), improved IRAD and IITA varieties, one cycle of about 12 months; sold fresh or processed into cossettes (dried chips), gari and baton (bobolo, miondo)

cycle.text: Varieties mature from 9 months; good yields at 12 to 24 months (S10). Sweet varieties 8 to 10 months, bitter from 12 months; late varieties 12 to 18 months (S2). Harvest 9 to 18 months after planting (S8).

planting.density: 1 m x 1 m, about 10,000 plants/ha (S2, S3); 6,000 to 10,000 in pure stands (S2).
planting.cuttings: 20 to 30 cm with 5 to 7 eyes, from 12 to 18 month old stems; hot water at 50 C for 15 min or a fungicide insecticide dip (S2, S3). Improved cuttings cost 25 to 50 FCFA each (S8); selected cuttings for 1 ha cost 260,000 FCFA in the CTA and ISF Cameroon budget (S2).
planting.timing: Start of the main rainy season; fill gaps 3 to 5 weeks after planting (S3).

fertility.organic: 10 to 20 t/ha of well decomposed manure on soils poor in humus, at land preparation (S1).
fertility.mineral: Urea 100 kg, triple superphosphate 100 kg and potassium sulphate 200 kg per ha (S3).

weeding.text: Three weedings, at 3 to 4, 7 to 9 and 12 to 14 weeks after planting (S3).

pests.text: Treat the variegated grasshopper (Zonocerus variegatus) only above 12 larvae per m2 (S3); use healthy cuttings against mosaic.

labour.per_ha: Soil preparation 50, cutting preparation 5, planting 15, upkeep 20, harvest 30 and carrying 40 person days per ha, 1,500 FCFA a day (S2). 75 to 125 person days from planting to harvest (S2).

gari.yield: 200 to 300 kg per t of roots (S2); 20 to 22 kg per 100 kg (S5); 825 kg from 2.5 t in the S2 cost table.
gari.costs: Per 2.5 t of roots: water and firewood 12,500 FCFA; 20 person days (peeling 5, washing 1, grating 6, pressing 2, sieving and roasting 4, grading 2) (S2).

cossettes.yield: 250 kg per t of roots (S2); 30 to 37 kg per 100 kg (S5).
cossettes.costs: Per t of roots in the East: peeling and washing 3,000 FCFA, drying 2,000, water 1,000 (S4).
cossettes.price: Processors sell at 160,000 to 200,000 FCFA per t in the East (S4); 219 to 257 FCFA/kg in northern markets in late 2022 (S9).

baton.yield: About 48 kg of chikwangue per 100 kg of roots, comparable to the traditional process; pieces of about 600 g sold 100 FCFA (Congo, S6).
baton.price: Douala, Saker market: bobolo 200 FCFA a piece, miondo 600 FCFA a stick (S7, 2022).

prices.fresh: Farm gate 65,000 to 100,000 FCFA per t, markets 70,000 to 105,000 FCFA per t (East, S4).
